question_or_proposition: Does the nominated clause require only submission of a detailed Delta-BHC study plan to EPA and NMED for approval within six months of the permit effective date, or does it also require Delta-BHC sampling or testing at the source water intake during that period?
required_context: Schedule of Compliance, Delta-BHC Study (Part I.B), including the immediately following sentence on plan content and post-approval quarterly sampling during permit years 2–5
Distinction between administrative plan-submission obligations and monitoring requirements that entail sample collection and analysis
notes: The nominated span describes a plan to test at the source water intake; resolving whether it establishes a monitoring obligation versus a plan-submission step alone determines FY2025 monitoring-applicability results and whether absent Delta-BHC results are in scope for missing-evidence classification.
